about: An ability that swallows a move takes it before the accuracy roll and the type chart: Showdown's gen-9 trySpreadMoveHit runs the TryHit step, where they act, before type immunity and accuracy, and Pokemon Central's Mangiaterra has Earth Eater come before the Flying type and an Air Balloon. A level-10 Pikachu is given Hydro Pump, Mud-Slap and Telekinesis in the running battle (teach:) against a forced wild level-5 Chansey that knows only Splash, brought to 20 of its 40 HP before each heal (set:). With the accuracy roll forced to miss, Hydro Pump (80% accurate; the forced roll does not make a sure hit miss) into its Water Absorb restores 10 HP; with the roll hitting again, Mud-Slap into its Earth Eater restores 10 under an Air Balloon and, the balloon taken away, 10 under Telekinesis. Before, the Hydro Pump missed and both Mud-Slaps were turned away by the lift. The field's RNG is pinned as in rolls_forced_high.json.

lines: The wild Chansey restored HP using its Water Absorb!
